args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). This PR upgrades fastjson to 2.9.4, the patched version in the 2.x line.

CI has passed on this branch.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Confirmed the vulnerability**: fastjson 2.8.0 is pinned in `requirements.txt`, and CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded recursion parsing deeply nested arrays) affects `<2.9.4` in the 2.x line. The fix is 2.9.4.
2. **Created branch** `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` from main.
3. **Upgraded** `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4` in `requirements.txt` and committed.
4. **Ran CI** (run `ci-0001`) — it passed.
5. **Opened PR #101** against `main` titled "Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337", requesting review from **alex**.

The PR is open and awaiting review; merging into main requires code-owner approval per policy.
